# External Dependencies

Do not vendor external simulator repositories into this repository.

PX4-Autopilot should be cloned outside this repository, for example:

```text
~/research/PX4-Autopilot
```

Future notes about Gazebo, MuJoCo, Hakoniwa, ROS2, or other simulator integrations may be documented here, but source trees should remain external unless there is a clear and approved reason.
